name: Southern Baptist Conservatives of Virginia
aliases: Southern Baptist Convention (SBC) — SBC of Virginia
source_policy: Official SBCV sources only (sbcv.org): the SBCV Constitution and Bylaws and the About page. The SBCV adopts the Baptist Faith and Message 2000; quotes from that confession are graded on the SBC page, not repeated here.

nuance.title: What SBCV affiliation means
paragraphs: The SBCV is a state convention of Southern Baptist churches in Virginia. Its constitution adds an explicit inerrancy clause to the Baptist Faith and Message 2000, which it adopts as its statement of fundamental truths.

Its doctrinal position binds no local church, but the SBCV sets the doctrinal parameters for affiliation and can rescind a church's affiliation. Churches stay autonomous; affiliation is the accountability.
Categories shown as unknown here are covered by the Baptist Faith and Message on the Southern Baptist Convention page; this page grades only what sbcv.org itself publishes.

rule.text: Each church is autonomous and the body disclaims any authority over it; its confession binds no church. Cooperation or affiliation can still require agreement with that confession → AUTONOMOUS.

ledger.quote: We believe that the Bible is the verbally inspired Word of God, wholly without error as originally given by God, and is sufficient as our only infallible rule of faith and practice.

As an autonomous state convention cooperating with the Southern Baptist Convention, the SBCV is a fellowship of Southern Baptist Convention churches cooperating to assist local congregations in their task of fulfilling the Great Commission

The doctrinal position of the Southern Baptist Conservatives of Virginia shall not be binding upon any local church; however, the SBCV recognizes its right and responsibility to determine its identity, including doctrinal parameters, and to include within its affiliation those churches who can freely agree with it

While autonomous in its own affairs, Southern Baptist Conservatives of Virginia, recognizing the autonomy of other Baptist bodies, disclaims all right of exercising authority over any church, association, or convention.
Our mission is coming alongside local churches advancing the Gospel of Jesus Christ together to reach our neighbors and the nations.
